thm-exact.scope: The nested-threshold injection does not give membership iff, finiteness, exact cardinality or either correction at 2 and 3.

lem-glaisher.scope: No matching frozen congruence identified; the growth proof does not use a congruence at all. Glaisher applies at all positive n and primes p at least 5, including p dividing n.

cor-growth.scope: Exactly the old nested-threshold witness implication; no sharp forward implication from n at least p_k cubed, no converse, and no finite count.

cor-companion.scope: No matching declaration identified: existence and minimality for the universal tail, empty W and n=5 require more than a witness injection.

cor-lower.scope: Cubic remainder under a nested threshold is a different modulus and conclusion. No exact combined mod-p and mod-p-squared counts identified.

cor-linked.scope: No matching collective declaration identified. MediumPNT bounds Chebyshev psi rather than stating the prime-power counts, boundary intervals, formal series or fixed-exponent ratios.
